prefill.semantics: Token overlap is native extend geometry at full-match/effective-prefix positions, not per-layer kernel work. Whole batch worker intervals are not allocated to gap tokens or interpreted as removable GPU time.

transfers.semantics: An anchor may cover other FULL nodes. Same-anchor later ACK is only an association, not per-component first-service reuse; unmatched D2H is not classified as wasted. Submit/ACK envelopes and transfer stream time are not measured scheduler CPU blocking or JCT savings.

limits: Client and native identities are joined exactly; no text similarity matching.
Missing prior-input probes are unknown, not zero.
Native prefix counters and worker intervals are not per-layer kernel FLOPs.
A matching FULL gap is not assumed to be removable Mamba recomputation.
No counterfactual throughput, quality or JCT improvement is established.
